messages:
Priya: FYI - ONYX Ltd renewal invoice INV-91745 exported with platform fee split into "61,500" and "58,500" line items. AR mapping fails because contract lists one annual platform fee of 120,000. Can billing ops advise? :mag:
Andre: Thanks. Is this the platform fee + a migration adjustment or two platform fees? Can you paste the export snippet?
Priya: Portal export shows:
- PLATFORM_ANNUAL: 61,500 (GL 4720)
- PLATFORM_MIGRATE_ADJ: 58,500 (GL 4799)
Customer says there was a support-tier consolidation in Dec but contract amendment AM-2023-DEC says single fee.
Ken: Looks like our migration pipeline emitted a separate adjustment line instead of merging into the platform fee. Two remediation options: 1) post clearing journal to reclass GL 4799->4720 and leave invoice; 2) issue credit memo for the migration adj and reissue single-line invoice. Which do we prefer from a customer-facing standpoint?
Priya: ONYX prefers a single invoice line for simplicity. They asked for minimal docs to process with their AP system.
Andre: Option 2 (credit memo + reissue) gives the clearest vendor view. Need approval to void the migration adj lines and reissue INV-91745-R1. Also need PR to log GL movement: PR-7352.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-91745 generated by billing-worker at 2012359988. Status: Pending.
Ken: Approving credit path. Please include "Consolidated per AM-2023-DEC" in the memo and reference original invoice number. Also require tagging in the journal PR.
Sasha: Confirmed with ONYX on call; they prefer reissue and asked to keep original invoice date as a memo field.
Andre: Created credit memo CM-528 at 2012360800 and drafted INV-91745-R1 with single platform fee line 120,000. Will post PR-7352 to reclass GL and link docs. ETA: 1 business day.
billing-bot: Credit memo CM-528 created at 2012360800 by billing-worker.
Priya: Once posted, I'll re-run AR ingest and confirm. Note: AR system requires a single revenue line on platform fees to match contract code.
Andre: PR-7352 posted and linked to CM-528 at 2012362200. GL moved from PLATFORM_MIGRATE_ADJ (4799) to PLATFORM_ANNUAL (4720).
Andre: INV-91745-R1 issued at 2012363000. Memo: "Consolidated per AM-2023-DEC. Ref: INV-91745"
billing-bot: AR import processed at 2012363400. Status: Success.
Priya: AR ingest succeeded. ONYX confirmed they reconciled on their end too.
Ken: I'll log a small billing rule change: prevent emitting migration adj as separate line when consolidation flag is set. Filing FR-9012 to track with eng-billing.
Sasha: Thanks team. Closing the thread once FR-9012 is linked to the billing repo. :white_check_mark:
